detail.longDescription: A multi-agent system without an orchestrator is just a collection of agents. Each one is capable, but none of them coordinated. It behaves like a group project with no project manager. This excerpt was taken from the eBook Inside Agentic Systems: https:// minox.cosmichive.com/inside-ag entic-systems/ # ai # agenticsystems # aisystems # llm # aiagents # aiagent # agenticai # agentic
